data.explanation: This is an invoice for chimney renovation work (new steel flue liner, connection piece and chimney sweep inspection) totaling €1,785.60. You need to pay this amount to the company's IBAN by the deadline shown, which the app calculates as 14 days from the invoice date. If you don't pay on time, the company could send a reminder (Mahnung) with possible late fees, though none are mentioned here. Check that the invoiced work matches what was actually done before paying.
